document.title: Authentication Flow (Updated)
document.content:
# Authentication Flow (Updated)

## Overview

This document describes the updated authentication flow for the Nyx platform, now using Clerk v5.

## Steps

1. User navigates to the login page.
2. User enters credentials or selects an OAuth provider (Google, GitHub, or SAML SSO).
3. Clerk handles session creation and token issuance.
4. The frontend stores the session token and redirects to the dashboard.
5. Multi-factor authentication is prompted if enabled for the organization.

## Token Refresh

Session tokens are short-lived (30 minutes). Clerk automatically refreshes tokens using a secure HTTP-only cookie.

## Logout

Calling `clerk.signOut()` invalidates the session on both client and server.

linkedRepo.remoteContent:
# Authentication Flow

## Overview

This document describes the authentication flow for the Nyx platform, migrated to Clerk v5 with PKCE support.

## Steps

1. User navigates to the login page.
2. User enters credentials or selects an OAuth provider (Google or GitHub).
3. Clerk handles session creation and token issuance via PKCE.
4. The frontend stores the session token and redirects to the dashboard.

## Token Refresh

Session tokens are short-lived (45 minutes). Clerk automatically refreshes tokens using a secure HTTP-only cookie with SameSite=Strict.

## Logout

Calling `clerk.signOut()` invalidates the session on both client and server. The refresh token is also revoked server-side.
